description:
We are actively hiring software and AI engineers to take part in designing, building, and operating fault tolerant neutral atom quantum computers. You will work in a tight-knit team, and will be responsible for building software and AI tools to facilitate research in fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures. Prior knowledge of quantum computing is not required. We are hiring at all experience levels, including post-bachelors, masters, PhD, and beyond.



Requirements:

 - Wants to build a quantum computer

 - Works well in a highly collaborative team environment



Compensation:

 - $200,000-$350,000/year depending on experience

 - Benefits (health and dental coverage, 401K, unlimited PTO, paid family leave, visa sponsorship)

 - Equity



Oratomic is an equal opportunity employer. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application process, contact info@oratomic.com.
